review_method: Read-only branch analysis; counterexamples below are source-provable omissions, not claims of executing GDScript.

findings.issue: Finite motion is unbounded. After removing seven physical fields, validator only requires age/bounces not to rewind; observation lacks elapsed clock/tick.
findings.counterexample: Use the candidate formal_set_motion on cloned after state to set age1e9, finite position/velocity/rotation1e20, or bounces1e9, synchronizing saved unit and raw pickup. Identity/amounts/keysets remain unchanged, motion fields are stripped, finite predicates pass, monotonic checks pass, ledgers unchanged. No condition rejects the impossible motion.
findings.fix: Record real stage.clock/physics tick and bound age/bounce increments and displacement/velocity/rotation using elapsed time and explicitly explained loose physical limits; reject synchronized finite explosion counterexamples.

findings.issue: A new region.claimed key with no actual pickup/unit ownership is accepted.
findings.counterexample: after.claimed[ghost_id]=true, no matching pickup, no grant, balance0. Unit-specific claim comparisons still pass; transition only retains preexisting claimed keys and never checks new orphan keys.
findings.fix: For this no-claims fixture retain complete claimed equality, or validate every new true claim against an actual current pickup/chest ownership record and exact receipt as appropriate. Add phantom-claim negative.

findings.issue: Preserving a nonempty old wallet ledger is implemented but not exercised by any real positive or derived positive/negative: six actual observations all have empty grants.
findings.fix: Add explicitly labeled clone controls with one preexisting grant preserved, then removed/changed; require expected old_grant_changed error, without claiming runtime exercised that preexisting grant.
